description: We are a creative team passionate about space, science, and technology. We are developing a Mars mission game using Scratch. We enjoy coding, designing, and solving problems. We are looking for creative and motivated members with skills in coding, graphic design, space science, data analysis, and teamwork. Everyone is welcome to share ideas and learn together. Let's make our mission a success! 🚀
summary: Mission Mars is an interactive Scratch game where players design and test their own Mars missions. Players choose a rocket, scientific instruments, and a power source while managing the mission's budget, mass, and power. During gameplay, they go through four tests to check their decisions and understand the challenges of space missions. The game shows whether a mission is ready for launch or will fail. It also teaches players about communication delays between Earth and Mars. Our goal is to make space exploration fun and help players understand how engineering decisions affect the success of a Mars mission.
details: Mission Mars is an interactive educational game developed using Scratch. It allows players to experience the process of planning a Mars mission by choosing a rocket, scientific instruments, and a power source. Players must manage the mission's budget, spacecraft mass, and power requirements. Throughout the game, they go through four tests that challenge their choices and show whether their mission can succeed or fail. Our project helps players understand the challenges of space exploration and how engineers make important decisions before launching a spacecraft. We used Scratch, a block-based programming platform, to create the game, its interactive screens, calculations, and results. Our creative idea was to turn space mission planning into a game where players learn by making their own decisions. We considered important factors such as cost, mass, power, and communication delays. The intended impact is to make space science easier to understand, encourage problem-solving, and inspire students to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).
